title: Iranian Official Claims Trump Switched Planes, Hid in Food Truck to Flee Turkey After Fake Threat
text:
Iranian Official Claims Trump Switched Planes, Hid in Food Truck to Flee Turkey After Fake Threat"

""
"A senior advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has leveled sharp criticism at former U.S. President Donald Trump, describing his departure from Turkey as a "scandal" for a superpower."

"In an interview with Russia's RT network, Sardar Naqdi detailed the alleged incident, stating that Trump changed his aircraft, hid inside a food truck, and then secretly boarded another plane to leave Turkey. "For a superpower, this behavior is a scandal in itself," Naqdi asserted."

"He went on to accuse Trump of cowardly and unethical conduct regarding his entourage. "What was worse was that he placed his Secretary of State, Marco Rubio, and a group of journalists on a plane that he believed would be targeted," Naqdi said. "This behavior by Trump was extremely cowardly and unethical.""

"Explaining the cause of the alleged security scare, Naqdi stated that Turkey's intelligence services had sent a letter regarding a report that the U.S. president's aircraft was going to be attacked. However, investigations later revealed that the source of the threat was an ordinary citizen."

""He said, 'I just wanted to scare the U.S. president,'" Naqdi quoted. "That simple letter led to the biggest scandal of Trump's life.
